### [`set_fighter_poses`](../../../../src/fighter/pose_update.asm#L6) `$8620`

*routine*

Not in build V 05 05 87. Sets fighter_pose of both fighters from the move sequence: the byte before fighter_move_step, or byte 0 at step 0.

- **Called from:** [`$80D6`](../../../../src/main/main_loop.asm#L16)
- **Reads:** [`fighter_move`](../../memory-map.md#fighter_move), [`move_seq_ptrs`](move_sequences.md#move_seq_ptrs), [`fighter_move_step`](../../memory-map.md#fighter_move_step), [`move_seq_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#move_seq_ptr)
- **Writes:** [`move_seq_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#move_seq_ptr), [`fighter_pose`](../../memory-map.md#fighter_pose)
- **Refers to:** [`move_seq_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#move_seq_ptr)
